audit.why: From level 4 Morgana's Dark Binding-into-Soul Shackles is the only real hard lockdown in the lane (Zilean's Q stun requires a double-bomb and his W/E offer no CC), giving Morgana the all-in through first item, while late Zilean's Chronoshift revive, E speed kiting Soul Shackles' radius, and his stun range let him take over — exactly what content whys[3..6] already state.
audit.corrected: phases[3-5].side -> Morgana, phases[6].side -> Zilean, ratings and why text adjusted to match the grounded content reasoning. Rows 0-2 left unchanged (already agree with content).

audit.why: Level 6 (Soul Shackles vs Chronoshift), first item (Bind-R through a single revive), and late (Zilean's utility scaling) spikes are already correctly and specifically stated in content.

edits.before: Bank the root and shield the engage attempts — the lane plays at your Q's pleasure.
edits.after: Bind into Soul Shackles is the only real lockdown — you dictate every all-in.

edits.before: Soul Shackles online — close-range fights end in a double stun you started.
edits.after: Soul Shackles beats his lack of engage even accounting for Chronoshift.

edits.before: First item: the root converts and the shields multiply.
edits.after: Bind-R chains CC to kill through a single Chronoshift.

edits.before: Late Morgana erases playbooks: black-shield the engage's target and root the diver who insisted.
edits.after: He scales into premier utility: Chronoshift revives, E kites your R radius, and his stun out-ranges Bind.

edits.before: W the pair, bank the Q visibly, shield the answer — the threat governs while the pool bills.
edits.after: Sidestep the first Time Bomb, then Bind him in the long recovery window.

edits.before: Q-poking into shields while their hook waits for yours to be down — the binding is the law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Don't burst blind into Chronoshift — bait or track the revive before you commit R.

edits.before: - Zilean Chronoshift: matchup-defining — The revive undoes your kill — force it early or swap focus when it glows. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Black Shield answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Chronoshift (R) is 120-60s CD by rank — the revive undoes your kill unless you force it early or swap focus when it glows. - Your E Black Shield answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
